items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... McLean. I think you use your knee or push something. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, it had a resonator. It had a resonator and an armrest and a head guard. Most of you see plenty of banjos today. The guy don't have no head guard on them. But that little piece covered the head. You know, when you hit with the pick that kept the head from getting black or something like that.

By the way, Lawrence showed me his banjo a couple years ago. He had a mute on it, too. I forget how Lawrence is... Yeah. Some sort of a mute. Yeah. Somebody else has one. McLean. I think you use your knee or push something.
